decision_scope: one fixed CP-ETC-Scan candidate, developed only by grouped out-of-fold evaluation on official DTU TEP Mode2 magnitude-50 runs

supersession_and_authorization.reason: The same-seed pyTEP reproduction compatibility probe failed. A fresh bank from that implementation cannot be treated as source-equivalent replication data.
supersession_and_authorization.authorization: The user authorized the previously numerically unread Mode2 magnitude-50 IDV1/3/9/15 runs 1-100 to become the sole v5 development set.
supersession_and_authorization.prior_byte_level_checks: OS file size and whole-file digests are provenance checks, not HDF5 numeric access.
supersession_and_authorization.no_fallback: No fresh simulation, alternate magnitude, additional fault, alternate fold, alternate seed, or Mode1 target data may be substituted after this freeze.

claim_boundary.design_label: cross-mode development followed by target-domain healthy threshold calibration and a once-only target-domain confirmation
claim_boundary.mode2_cv_interpretation: The five outer folds are internal out-of-fold development evidence. They are not the final independent confirmation and leave no unused Mode2 magnitude-50 estimate after final refitting.
claim_boundary.mode1_interpretation: Mode1 is a distinct simulator mode used as the target domain. Mode1 magnitude-25 healthy runs calibrate only the final run threshold; Mode1 magnitude-75 is the once-only target-domain confirmation.
claim_boundary.external_domain_rule_for_resimulation: A MATLAB R2024b or other reimplementation output is not a replicate merely because a nominal seed matches. Unless an independently frozen reproduction gate passes schema, schedule, metadata, and predeclared numeric trajectory tolerances, it is a separate simulator/external domain and cannot replace any role in this protocol.
claim_boundary.current_r2024b_disposition: The failed same-seed compatibility probe is treated as a reproduction NO-GO; its output is excluded from training, calibration, testing, and sample-size claims.

atomic_freeze_requirement: This JSON must exist and parse as JSON.
Its SHA256 sidecar must match its exact bytes.
A commit sidecar must bind the protocol filename, protocol SHA256, sidecar filename, and sidecar SHA256.
Only after all three artifacts exist may Mode2 HDF5 topology, attributes, metadata, seeds, or processdata be opened.
access_governance.first_authorized_h5_action: After atomic freeze, create a durable append-only access-intent record naming this protocol hash, source hash, selected paths, UTC timestamp, code revision, and operator before opening Mode2.
access_governance.fail_closed: Any digest, topology, metadata, seed, shape, dtype, time-axis, IDV schedule, finiteness, or uniqueness failure ends v5 as DATA_CONTRACT_NO_GO. Do not search for a more favorable subset or modify the protocol.
access_governance.mode1_guard: Development code must not open the Mode1 HDF5 file, enumerate its HDF5 keys, read attributes, read seeds, or decode numeric arrays before DEVELOPMENT_GO. Previously known whole-file byte digests do not authorize HDF5 access.
access_governance.result_immutability: Outer-fold predictions and metrics are append-only. A fold may not be rerun to replace an unfavorable finite result; reruns are allowed only for a documented infrastructure failure before metrics are revealed, with identical code, data, and seeds.
access_governance.no_adaptive_iteration: Any architecture, loss, feature, endpoint, threshold, fold, hyperparameter, data cleaning, or metric change after Mode2 numeric access creates a new version and v5 remains NO_GO.

R.name: reproduction compatibility gate
R.consequence: No fresh pyTEP bank is generated or used.

C1.name: final per-expert endpoint ECDF score-map fit
C1.data: Mode2 magnitude-50 IDV1 healthy pre-fault segments, runs 1-100
C1.independence_note: C1 reuses development-domain healthy runs after DEVELOPMENT_GO and is a fixed monotone score mapping, not an independent false-alarm calibration set.

C2.name: independent target-domain run-threshold calibration
C2.data: Mode1 magnitude-25 IDV1 pre-fault segments, runs 1-100
C2.allowed_action: Score with the frozen Mode2 model, transforms, and C1 ECDF; choose ascending rank 96 of 100 run maxima.
C2.forbidden_action: Do not refit the ECDF, network, normalization, AE, loop parameters, features, scan, or any hyperparameter on C2.

role_ledger.note: C1 is a reuse of E and therefore is not added again to the unique-hour total. Each 500-sample analytic sequence spans 25 process hours at 0.05 hour per sample.

idv_roles.1: healthy control from the pre-fault slice only

mode2_development_data_contract.path_resolution: Exactly one completed-or-stopped path must resolve for each selected IDV/run pair; duplicates or missing paths are fatal.

seed_audit.collision_policy: Any missing, unparsable, non-scalar, or repeated seed is DATA_CONTRACT_NO_GO and must be reported; do not repair, relabel, or select replacement runs.
seed_audit.run_id_semantics: The same run_id across IDV1/3/9/15 is only a balanced stratification block. It must not be interpreted as a shared seed, matched realization, pairing, or common random number.

folds.balanced_block_note: Placing equal run_id values in one fold guarantees 20 observations per IDV per fold but conveys no seed pairing.

outer_loop.outer_access: Score each outer fold once after its model, fit-health ECDF arrays, and inner-health threshold are frozen.

candidate.selection: No model selection, hyperparameter sweep, ensemble, early stopping, alternate initialization, or post-access feature editing is allowed.

windowing.endpoint_definition: A window with endpoint t is x[t-127:t+1], using zero-based half-open slicing x[t-127,t+1).

normalization.fit_data: All timepoints in the 60 fit-healthy analytic sequences only, calculated independently in each outer fold.
normalization.final_refit: Recompute once from all 100 Mode2 healthy analytic sequences after DEVELOPMENT_GO.
normalization.leakage_rule: Inner, outer, Mode1, and fault-positive values never affect the normalization fit.

encoder: grouped Conv1d 52->208, groups=52, kernel=7, stride=2, padding=3
grouped Conv1d 208->104, groups=52, kernel=5, stride=2, padding=2
decoder: grouped ConvTranspose1d 104->208, groups=52, kernel=4, stride=2, padding=1
grouped ConvTranspose1d 208->52, groups=52, kernel=4, stride=2, padding=1
channel_denoising_autoencoder.training_windows: All 93 windows from fit-healthy runs only.
channel_denoising_autoencoder.corruption: For each training example and timepoint draw M~Bernoulli(0.10), broadcast M across channels, and iid epsilon~Normal(0,0.05^2); input is (1-M)*x + epsilon while target is clean x.
channel_denoising_autoencoder.post_training: Freeze every AE parameter before classifier training.

spectral_preprocessing.detrend: Subtract that window's own time mean.
spectral_preprocessing.power: P_k=abs(rFFT(x_demeaned*Hann)_k)^2/sum(Hann^2); multiply one-sided interior bins k=1..63 by 2; set DC k=0 to zero; do not double Nyquist k=64.

loop_features.dwell_threshold: From each fit-healthy original run after global normalization, pool each unique non-overlapping transition du=u[t]-u[t-1]. tau_d=max(numpy linear quantile(abs(du),q=0.20),1e-6).
u_features_in_order: slip=(1/(W-4))*sum over t=4..W-2 of I(the preceding four du values are all <=tau_d and abs(du_t)>tau_d)*log1p((abs(du_t)/tau_d)^2)
reversal=mean(I(du_t*du_(t-1)<0)) over defined consecutive du pairs

response_features_repeated_in_order_for_.lag_asymmetry: max over l=1..8 abs(PearsonCorr(u[:-l],y[l:])) minus max over l=1..8 abs(PearsonCorr(y[:-l],u[l:])); floor every Pearson denominator at 1e-8
response_features_repeated_in_order_for_.arx_residual_ratio: Fit y_t=beta0+beta1*y_(t-1)+beta2*u_(t-1)+r_t on all unique fit-healthy transitions by ridge solve with penalty diag(0,1e-4,1e-4). Let denom_y=max(median across fit-healthy windows of mean(r^2),1e-8). Window feature=log1p(mean(r^2)/denom_y).
response_features_repeated_in_order_for_.welch_coherence: Within the length-128 window use seven segments length32 at starts 0,16,...,96. Demean each segment and use periodic Hann32. Average Sxx,Syy,Sxy across segments using the same one-sided scaling. C_k=clip(abs(Sxy_k)^2/(Sxx_k*Syy_k+1e-12),0,1). Feature=sum(C_k*Sxx_k,k=1..16)/(sum(Sxx_k,k=1..16)+1e-12).

loop_features.final_u_feature: XMV non-DC PSD concentration=max(P_k,k=1..64)/Qeps using the frozen length-128 PSD definition.
loop_features.fitting_scope: tau_d, both ARX coefficient vectors, and both denom_y values use fit healthy only and are frozen before inner or outer scoring.
loop_features.linear_algebra_guard: Use a direct float64 solve; pseudoinverse is forbidden. Failure, nonfinite coefficients, or condition number above 1e12 is a fold-level numeric NO_GO.

classifier.channel_embedding: Learned channel-ID embedding dimension 4, concatenated with 14 fixed features to make 18 inputs per channel.
classifier.heads: Three independent heads, one per ordered fault expert 3/9/15; each Linear 40->16, GELU, Linear 16->1.
classifier.expert_labels: Expert e uses its own fault e as positive and healthy as negative. Other fault types are never negatives for that expert.
classifier.parameter_scale_note: Approximately twenty thousand trainable parameters; the implemented exact count must be reported but is not a tuning target.

mil_training.fault_positive_bag: For the target fault, take its 85 monitor logits and average the largest 9 (fixed top-10-percent count).
mil_training.healthy_negative_bag: For healthy, take all 93 endpoint logits and average the largest 10 (fixed top-10-percent count).
mil_training.fault_prefix_negative_bag: For the same target fault, take the 8 prefix logits and use the largest 1.
mil_training.total_loss: Arithmetic mean of the three expert losses.
mil_training.epoch_definition: Independently shuffle the 60 fit runs of each of the four classes with the fixed generator; use eight joint batches, keeping the final four runs rather than dropping them. Each step contains one healthy batch and one batch for each target fault.

determinism.training_device: CUDA RTX 5090 when the fixed environment passes preflight
determinism.failure_policy: A nondeterministic unsupported operation, nonfinite value, CUDA OOM, or environment mismatch is infrastructure failure, not permission to modify the model.

tail_mapping_and_scan.loo_scope: LOO-ECDF may exist only as an algorithm unit test on synthetic fixtures. It is superseded operationally and may not supply any v5 threshold or score.

per_fold_expert_ecdf.fit_source: The 60 fit-healthy runs only, using all 85 monitor endpoints for that expert.
per_fold_expert_ecdf.tie_rule: Reference values equal to the query count in the upper tail through >=.
per_fold_expert_ecdf.inner_data_role: The 20 inner healthy runs do not fit or update the endpoint ECDF. They are transformed by the already frozen fit-healthy ECDF.

fusion.winner: argmin over p values in expert order [3,9,15]; exact ties choose the lowest array index, hence fault 3 first.

scan.formula: At monitor endpoint k, S_k is the sum of the two largest fused evidence values among the latest min(8,k) monitor endpoints.
scan.eligibility: At least two monitor endpoints must have been observed, so the first eligible endpoint is 164.
scan.alarm: The earliest eligible endpoint with S_k strictly greater than h.

inner_threshold.procedure: Use the frozen fit-healthy endpoint ECDF to obtain one run maximum for each of the 20 inner healthy runs, then set h to their maximum, equivalently ascending rank 20.
inner_threshold.nondegeneracy: At least 19 of the 20 maxima must be exactly distinct, and rank20-rank19 must exceed 100*eps_float64*max(1,abs(rank20),abs(rank19)).

per_fold: resolved run IDs for fit, inner healthy, unused inner faults, and outer test
all source and code hashes plus environment manifest
seed audit evidence without changing fold assignment
normalization, dwell, ARX, ECDF, checkpoint, and threshold artifact hashes
20 inner healthy run maxima and their sorted ranks
outer alarm endpoint, delay or miss, winning expert, and p/e/S paths for each run
healthy endpoint winner counts and shares
aggregate: healthy false alarms overall and by fold
fault detection rate overall and by fold for faults 3,9,15
fault delay median and nearest-rank p90 with misses coded 340
attribution confusion matrix as descriptive output only
all gate booleans and the single final DEVELOPMENT_GO or DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO decision
development_outputs_required.attribution_status: report-only secondary analysis; classification accuracy is not a detection GO gate

winner_dominance.population: Every outer healthy monitor endpoint, regardless of whether an alarm occurs.

development_go_gates.threshold_nondegeneracy: Required in every fold using the frozen 19-distinct and top-gap rule.

cuda_parity.procedure: For each frozen fold checkpoint, run identical outer inference and tail/scan calculations on CPU and CUDA.

development_go_gates.logic: DEVELOPMENT_GO only if every gate passes in every required scope. Any single failure yields DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO.
development_go_gates.no_rescue: A DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO forbids Mode1 magnitude-25 and magnitude-75 access for v5 and forbids changing v5 to rescue the outcome.

final_mode2_refit.training_data: All Mode2 magnitude-50 runs 1-100 for IDV1 healthy and faults 3/9/15, using the identical candidate and seed.
final_mode2_refit.normalization_and_loop_fit: Fit only all 100 Mode2 healthy analytic sequences.
final_mode2_refit.ae_fit: Fit only all 100 Mode2 healthy analytic sequences with the frozen AE procedure.
final_mode2_refit.expert_fit: Fit using all 100 Mode2 healthy runs and all 100 runs of each target fault with the frozen MIL procedure.
final_mode2_refit.endpoint_ecdf: For each expert, fit once on all 85 monitor logits from all 100 Mode2 healthy runs, N=8500, with p=(1+count(z>=q))/(8501).
final_mode2_refit.important: The Mode2 ECDF remains fixed throughout C2 and L; Mode1 never refits it.

mode1_c2_target_threshold.procedure: After final model, transforms, loop fits, Mode2 ECDF, code revision, and environment are frozen, score the 100 Mode1 healthy runs once and compute their run maxima.
mode1_c2_target_threshold.rank_rationale: Under exchangeability of the fixed target-domain healthy run maxima with a future target healthy run, the marginal exceedance probability is at most 5/101. This is not a cross-mode IID guarantee.
mode1_c2_target_threshold.nondegeneracy: All values must be finite; at least 96 maxima must be exactly distinct; rank96 must be separated from rank95 by more than 100*eps_float64*max(1,abs(rank96),abs(rank95)); rank96 must be strictly below rank100.
mode1_c2_target_threshold.failure: Any failure is CALIBRATION_NO_GO; do not open Mode1 magnitude-75.

mode1_l_once_only_confirmation.access: One pass only after a durable lockbox access intent binds every final artifact and h_target hash.
mode1_l_once_only_confirmation.decision: CONFIRMATION_PASS only if every listed gate passes; otherwise CONFIRMATION_FAIL. Results are reported regardless of outcome and are never used for tuning.
mode1_l_once_only_confirmation.false_alarm_claim_rule: Report the exact Clopper-Pearson 95% interval. If more than 4 of 100 healthy runs alarm, do not claim the healthy-run false-alarm probability is below 0.10 even when the operational confirmation gate of at most 10 alarms passes.

post_development_go.quarantine: Mode1 magnitude-25 fault segments remain unused and quarantined. Previously consumed Mode1 magnitude-50 development data remain excluded.

synthetic_only: PSD bin, one-sided scaling, entropy, and centroid test

Bonferroni fusion and expert tie-order test

LOO-ECDF algorithm test explicitly marked non-operational

implementation_tests_before_real_data.restriction: Synthetic tests may correct an implementation that contradicts this text before real numeric access. They may not change the frozen method.
